# Genuine World6 / v0.7 compatibility fixtures

These six saves were originally emitted by unmodified gameplay and save code at
local commit `84cc5f8`, Godot 4.6.3 stable (`7d41c59c4`), not made by removing
fields from World7. They were regenerated byte-for-byte from the public
[finite-profile source](https://github.com/haohongfei2001-png/luanshi-game/commit/e337c3f56accffa5ba7293f90bf85197397a0007),
whose tree `b39852b10b62050609166e5e8f4018c25aad781e` exactly matches local `c0c6d53`.
All twelve envelopes/complete-state expectations retain their original SHA-256. Three profiles each have a running battle (live guard and fractional time)
and its real physical withdrawal/committed continuation. No hits, positions,
casualties or results were injected. `.codec.json` files preserve every original
state field; `.save.json` are the original v1 transport bytes.

Reproduce from a detached checkout of public commit `e337c3f56accffa5ba7293f90bf85197397a0007` with:

```
godot --headless --path /path/to/world6-checkout --editor --import
godot --headless --path /path/to/world6-checkout \
  --script /path/to/current/tools/capture_world6_fixtures.gd \
  -- /path/to/current/tests/fixtures/v07
```

The helper explicitly requires `World.VERSION == 6`. The World7 migration tests
remove only mode/origin/youth and ticket purpose/authority metadata when comparing to
these originals. Original HP, seeds, RNG, timers, outcomes, event history,
inventories, locks and all receipt fields must remain identical.
